name: Sonic Dive
source:
Although "Mugen no Meikyu" series was the contents of a game by which an enemy and an ally act by turns in the turn system, it is that it is changed into the action RPG by real time until now. "level "which geographical feature changes" makes still common the characteristic rule 1 to" with the previous work. Since Laila of a previous work "Sonic Princess" will mainly fight with an enemy by the elated magic which serves as a female hero, unlike action using an old sword, it becomes a colorful battle using magic. The whole atmosphere has taken in atmosphere like On-line MMORPG. For example, a character will also change Gurafikku, if a dress, arms, accessories, etc. are changed. A previous work also changes colorfully even to a dress this time, although the graphics of arms or a shield were changing. Since a hero is a woman, new items, such as a swimming suit, a sailor suit, and nurse dress, also appear.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302130108/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1000636]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
此前《无限迷宫》系列采用敌我交替行动的回合制，本作则改为实时动作角色扮演游戏。前作中“每升一级，地形便会变化”的特色规则依然得到保留。与旧作挥剑战斗的方式不同，前作《Sonic Princess》的女主角蕾拉主要使用令人热血沸腾的魔法对敌，战斗因此更加绚丽多彩。

整体氛围还融入了网络大型多人在线角色扮演游戏的特色。例如更换服装、武器和饰品后，角色外观也会随之变化。前作只有武器或盾牌的图像会改变，本作则连服装也更加丰富。由于主角是女性，还新增了泳装、水手服和护士服等物品。

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302130108/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1000636]Eroge Shop[/url]]
